title: Gymnosperms

conceptScope.en: COL26.8 accepted-species routing includes living cycads, Ginkgo, conifers and gnetophytes; in the pinned catalogue, gnetophytes enter through the routed Pinopsida root. Four field-linked profiles keep cycad total-evidence models, the bounded Ginkgoxylon wood specimen, a sampled living-conifer dated tree and Araucariaceae specimen-plus-matrix evidence separate from direct fossil first appearances or ancestor sequences. A gnetophyte dossier remains pending; every published range is source-bounded or explicitly withheld.
conceptScope.zh: COL26.8 已接受物种路由包含现生苏铁类、银杏类、针叶树类和买麻藤类；在固定目录中，买麻藤类经已路由的松柏纲根进入本包。四份逐字段档案把苏铁类全证据模型、范围受限的 Ginkgoxylon 木材标本、现生松柏类定年树取样以及南洋杉科标本与矩阵证据，与直接化石首现或祖先序列严格分开。买麻藤类档案仍待补充；所有已发布区间均有来源边界或被明确保留。

limitations: Package dossiers expose the current curated evidence boundary; unavailable fields are explicit and are not inferred.
